'''Supreme Commander''', also referred to as '''Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces''', '''Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet''', '''Supreme Fleet Commander''', '''Supreme Commander of the Imperial Military''' or simply '''Commander of the Imperial Fleet''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military title]] given to the senior-most [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]], who also exercised direct authority over the entirety of the [[Imperial Military]]. Within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s power structure, the title designated the second-highest official.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was the first to hold the office of Supreme Commander under the Galactic Empire, and held authority over the entirety of the Imperial Military, a role that would be held by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during the post-[[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. During the [[Imperial Civil War]], several [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] also claimed authority as Supreme Commander. 

The mantle of Supreme Commander was notably assumed by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who held the military duties and responsibilities over the scattered territories of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. 

==History==
===Before Endor===
Sometime following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ascension in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]' aftermath, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] appointed his handpicked [[Sith apprentice/Legends|right-hand]], [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|Darth Vader]], to the office of Supreme Commander,<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> charging him with maintaining order throughout [[Imperial Space]] and leading the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] in its major operations,<ref name="swdtfc1" /> such as the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> As such, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] personally supervised a number of early Imperial campaigns, including two [[Battle of Kashyyyk (disambiguation)|pacifications]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>, the quelling of the [[Vaklin insurgency]],<ref name="Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref> the disastrous [[Shrouded Offensive]],<ref name="Cry 3">[[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 3|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 3]]</ref> and the [[Bombing of Callos|Battle of Callos]].<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> Throughout his tenure, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] retained direct command of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], whose actions at his behest earned them the nickname of "Vader's Fist".<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader's position also allowed him to select the very best [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and crew to serve aboard his first [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]],<ref name="Characters" /> the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] ''[[Exactor/Legends|Exactor]]'' and ''[[Devastator/Legends|Devastator]]'' respectively.

As part of expanding his and Palpatine's dominions, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader also brought the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], a formidable warrior people, into the Empire's service as the elite [[Noghri Death Commando]]s.<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> He also oversaw the training and operations of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], as well as their hunt for the last [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="ea:r">''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]''</ref>

His duties and powers were not limited to command on the field, however. As part of the [[Emperor's purge]],<ref name="Loyalties">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]]</ref> Lord Vader played a key role in vanquishing traitors within the Empire's own ranks, which included preventing mutinies such as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]]' [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]].<ref name="GhostPrison1">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 1]]</ref> He also owned the ''[[Empirical]]'',<ref name="TFUd">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed#The Force Unleashed Databank|''The Force Unleashed Databank'']]</ref> a modified [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] which housed a mobile laboratory used to conduct experiments and studies on [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and unique [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, which he briefly entrusted to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rom Mohc]] for the [[Dark Trooper Project]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The vessel was rumored to be part of a fleet of such vessels under the Supreme Commander's command.<ref name="TFUd" /> Circa [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Lord Vader commissioned the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]] to secretly re-create a dangerous viral agent as [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Vector (Star Destroyer)|Vector]]''. The Supreme Commander had hoped to weaponize the pathogen and use it to eradicate the growing number of insurgents and freedom-fighters, but things eventually went awry and the program failed.<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>

Despite his involvement as an overseer in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] project since early on,<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> the cyborg's position was of no relevance within the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] own [[Battle Station Command/Legends|chain-of-command]], with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] - [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Oversector Outer]] - serving as [[Commander/Legends|commander]],<ref name="Episode IV2">{{Film|IV}}</ref> while Lord Vader stood by him as Emperor Palpatine's [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]].

[[File:VaderKaida.jpg|thumb|left|250px|As Supreme Commander, Darth Vader was the ranking leader of the Imperial Military.]]
As the Empire [[Battle of Yavin/Legends#Aftermath|retaliated]] against the Rebellion in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Emperor Palpatine consolidated Lord Vader's powers as Supreme Commander, formally conferring the latter military, political and administrative authority second only to that of his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]]; the changes to office were subsequently announced in a communique by Lord [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook2">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Following the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor's]] holomessage, the Emperor's lieutenant assembled the armada known as [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] to strike back at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for the Yavin debacle. For his pursuit of the elusive [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]], Lord Vader selected the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]],'' the first [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] and the largest [[Warship/Legends|war vessel]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], to be his flagship.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

For the next three years and more, Lord Vader hunted down the Rebels&mdash;and in particular, his son [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;all across the known galaxy, leading the ''Executor'' and her attached armada of Star Destroyers through the battles of [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as well as other campaigns, which saw him scoring notable victories and hounding his quarry wherever they hid.

On the Emperor's behalf, the Supreme Commander also sanctioned progress on several programs that impressed him, believing they could potentially change the course of the ongoing conflict in the Empire's favor. As such, Lord Vader personally authorized continued progress on General Rom Mohc's [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark Troopers]]<ref name="Dark">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> and inspecting [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]].<ref name="tf">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref> In addition, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was tasked with keeping tabs on the development of the Death Star II above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Lord Vader also helped handle the [[Zaarin insurrection|coup]] headed by the treacherous Grand Admiral Zaarin,<ref name="tf" /> and was also left as interim power and protector of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] in the occasional absence of Palpatine in the months that encompassed the preparations for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SotE novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Although Lord Vader did not command directly at Endor,<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] believed that he did.<ref name="Heir" /> In reality, it was Vader's second-in-command, Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], who directed the naval aspect of the confrontation with the Rebellion from the bridge of ''Executor''.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===After Endor===
{{Quote|My father's destiny is my own.|Luke Skywalker submits to serving the reborn Palpatine, taking Vader's title as the Empire's new Supreme Commander|audio=MyFathersDestinyIsMyOwn.flac|<ref name="Dark Empire audio">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Vader's death, along with that of Palpatine, threw the Empire into turmoil. After Endor, it is unclear whether any new Supreme Commander was appointed by any of the factions claiming to rule the Empire, and no obvious leader emerged until Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] returned from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Heir" />

[[File:PalpcloneLukeSkywalker-Hasbro.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Luke Skywalker served the reborn Emperor Palpatine as Supreme Commander]]
After Thrawn's death at [[Bilbringi]],<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> the struggle for power between Imperial factions precipitated a civil war, out of which emerged the "reborn" Palpatine in a series of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] bodies, ruling from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Against this background, Rebel hero Luke Skywalker took up<ref name="DE 2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> his father's old post<ref name="kenner" /> of Supreme Commander,<ref name="DE 3" /> part of a remarkable battle of wills between Palpatine and the Jedi Master. Palpatine knew that Luke was attempting to bring down the Empire from the inside, and Luke knew that Palpatine was hoping to seduce him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DE 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref> As Supreme Commander, Luke deliberately fought a wasteful and destructive campaign designed to cripple the Imperial war machine<ref name="endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref> and ensured the destruction of the [[World Devastator]]s; although it seemed for a time that Palpatine's machinations had nevertheless eclipsed the good man that he was, threatening to plunge the galaxy into a new dark age. Ultimately, the son of Anakin Skywalker returned to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]], and joined with his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and his unborn nephew [[Anakin Solo]] to destroy the tyrant.<ref name="DE 6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>

The demise of Palpatine's clone and Skywalker's return to the New Republic did not, however, prompt a crisis to compare with that which had ensued after Endor; command passed smoothly to [[Sedriss QL]]<ref name="Dark Empire II 1">[[Dark Empire II 1|''Dark Empire II'' 1]]</ref>, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-adept]] Imperial, as well as a distant descendant of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]],<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|85|SED 1-4|Exekutor Sedress (German Edition)}}</ref> with the rank of Military Executor.<ref name="The Dark Side Sourcebook">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Be that as it may, Executor Sedriss took over Supreme Commander Skywalker's role in charge of the galaxywide campaign code-named [[Operation Shadow Hand]], and continued in this capacity when another, final clone of Palpatine awoke on Byss<ref name="Dark Empire II 1" />. After Sedriss's death, another Dark Jedi, [[Xecr Nist]], was appointed his successor<ref name="Dark Empire II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>, but was [[Mission to Vjun (Operation Shadow Hand)|defeated]] by Skywalker and [[Kam Solusar]].<ref name="EE 1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref> After that, he became a prisoner of war and died in captivity following the destruction of Palpatine's final clone.<ref name="Characters" />

===Imperial reunification===
{{Main|Imperial Reunification}}
[[File:Pellaeon_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]]]
It was instead Admiral [[Natasi Daala]] who next emerged to lead the Imperial war machine. After Imperial authorities decommissioned her crippled flagship, she appointed herself to a roving ambassadorial commission, uniting the rival warlords' forces by assassinating their leaders and combining their fleets under her command, with all the powers of a Supreme Commander or Military Executor and, to an extent, the trappings of an "[[Empress/Legends|Empress]]," such as a cadre of [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

Following the [[Assault on Yavin 4|debacle at Yavin]], Daala surrendered her command to [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] Gilad Pellaeon, who was soon after found serving the Moff Council as the titular "Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet".<ref name="Darksaber" />

Pellaeon's evolving powers in this capacity were best demonstrated by his otherwise cautious proposal to the Moff Council in favor of peace with the New Republic in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] as compared to his far sterner approach to politics during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>, particularly following the [[Battle of Bastion|fall of Bastion]]<ref name="NJO FH 1 Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> Even with these consolidated powers, animosity between the military and civil sectors of Imperial politics would remain high, as evidenced by an [[Sinister Triumvirate|attempted coup]] and Pellaeon's eventual assassination, both machinations of Moffs.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> <ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

===Imperial Space after the Pellaeon&ndash;Gavrisom Treaty===
After peace was secured between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and Imperial Space in the form of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]]<ref name="Vision of the Future" />, the position of Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet became one of the most important posts in the Imperial government. Pellaeon was the chief Imperial negotiator and signatory to the peace treaty, and by some means, he came to assume the rank of Grand Admiral and also the chairmanship of the Council of Moffs, thus making him effectively both the commander-in-chief of Imperial forces and Imperial head-of-state.<ref name="NJO DT 2 Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>

As Grand Admiral Pellaeon had been the only Imperial Supreme Commander in the post-treaty era, it is unknown whether he wielded his authority as a constitutionally appointed magistrate, or through personal prestige and precedent. With the Imperial Remnant later a part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], it was also unknown what political powers the Supreme Commander still retained. By [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], Pellaeon was already known specifically as ''Grand Admiral of the Imperial Fleet''.<ref name="NJO FH 1 Remnant" />

==Ascension to the post==
The several Supreme Commanders who led the Imperial war machine came to power in a variety of different ways. Luke Skywalker served when Palpatine was reborn in a clone body<ref name="DE 3" /> and as did Xecr Nist.<ref name="Dark Empire II 4" /> As Grand Admiral, Thrawn was the highest-ranking remaining officer in the military, and Daala assumed command by killing off the thirteen most powerful warlords and taking control of their fleets. Daala later relinquished command to Pellaeon.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Evolution of powers==
At its inception, the title and position were granted to Darth Vader. It seems that in this capacity, Vader's powers were those of [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] of all Imperial forces, answering only to Emperor Palpatine. When Vader died at the Battle of Endor<ref name="ROTJ" />, the position officially seems to have disappeared as a successor or second-in-command was never made apparent. Indeed, the separation of the military from the state's civil government is made most apparent by the fact that those who immediately thereafter claimed the throne seemed to not claim or appoint anyone to this post.

The next confirmed usage of the title came in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the reign of Palpatine's clones. This time, though, it was Vader's son, Luke Skywalker, who assumed the title of Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces.<ref name="endnotes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title and its position and powers within the Imperial government have been an area of controversy and confusion. For the purposes of this article, the various titles are treated as one, but their powers over time have changed.
